events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hi, this is Renee at Bluebonnet Family Clinic calling about the lab order Dr. Osei placed for you.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Oh good. I tried to look it up but I can't get into the portal.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: The insurer rejected the billing code, so I need to transfer the order to a different lab. Your results should go through by Friday.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Okay. Hang on, I'm logging into the portal now, it's sending me something.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Great. Keep that code to yourself, we never need it. I'll hold while it loads, please don't hang up.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: Got it, I can see the order now. Thanks.
